basics.title: Basics
basics.subtitle: Walk, collect chips and reach the exit.

refresher.title: CC1 Refresher
refresher.subtitle: Classic Chip's Challenge tiles and monsters, with the places where Epoxy differs.

move.title: First Steps
move.hint: Move with the arrow keys or WASD (phone: joystick or tap). Step on a hint tile to read a tip, then reach the exit.

chips.title: Chips and the Socket
chips.hint: Collect every chip. The socket stays shut until you hold them all, then it opens and lets you through to the exit.

detour.title: The Long Way Round
detour.hint: The exit is close but the socket blocks it. Walk away from it, gather all the chips, then come back.

secret_walls.title: Walls That Lie
secret_walls.hint: Bump a blue wall: a fake one vanishes, a real one becomes a plain wall (blue in CC1). Some walls never show. Pop-up walls close behind you.

thin_walls.title: Thin Walls
thin_walls.hint: A thin wall blocks one edge of its tile only. Enter from the open sides, never across the blocked edge. Epoxy lets any tile carry one.

dirt_gravel.title: Dirt and Gravel
dirt_gravel.hint: Dirt turns into floor once you step on it, gravel stays. You can cross both, but monsters can enter neither.

keys.title: Keys and Doors
keys.hint: A key opens the door of its colour. Red, blue and yellow keys are used up by the door; the green key is kept and opens every green door.

elements.title: Water, Fire and Boots
elements.hint: Water drowns you and fire burns you. Flippers make water safe, fire boots make fire safe. Pick the boots up before you cross.

ice.title: Ice and Skates
ice.hint: On ice you slide until something stops you, and corners turn you. Ice skates let you walk on ice normally, so grab them to stop where you want.

force.title: Force Floors
force.hint: Force floors push you along. A random one pushes any way. Suction boots let you walk against them.

toggle.title: Toggle Walls
toggle.hint: A green button flips every toggle wall: closed ones open, open ones close. Think about which side you will stand on when you press it.

teleport.title: Teleporters
teleport.hint: A teleporter sends you to the previous one in reading order, looping. If its exit side is blocked you step out of another free side (CC1 tries the next pad).

followers.title: Wall Huggers
followers.hint: Bugs keep a wall on their left, paramecia on their right. Pink balls bounce straight back and forth. Watch their pattern, then slip past.

skewers.title: Gliders and Fireballs
skewers.hint: Gliders and fireballs fly straight and turn when blocked: gliders favour left, fireballs right. Gliders cross water, fireballs cross fire.

wanderers.title: Walkers and Blobs
wanderers.hint: Walkers go straight, then turn at random when blocked. Blobs wander at random. Gravel keeps them off: cross the open gap only when both are far.

teeth.title: Teeth
teeth.hint: Teeth chase you at half your speed but cannot pass walls. Watch it track you from below as you walk to the exit.

tank.title: Tanks
tank.hint: A tank rolls straight until blocked, then waits. A blue button reverses every tank. Press it to send the tank back.

trap.title: Traps
trap.hint: A trap holds you while its brown button is empty. Keep pressing the way out: you leave when the bug stands on the button.

clone.title: Clone Machines
clone.hint: A red button makes its clone machine copy the monster inside. The new tank rolls on and parks on the brown button, opening the trap.

button.hint: Learn the game one mechanic at a time

body.label: A tutorial now teaches the game one mechanic at a time, room by room. Try it whenever you like.

1.title: Outer Sluices & Counterweights
1.subtitle: Sequential boulder trenches, counterweight hold gates and elemental alchemy.

2.title: Cryo Ducts & Boot Tolls
2.subtitle: Frictionless glacier slides, conveyor loops, boot tolls and grappling extractions.

3.title: Automata Escapements & Rail Foundries
3.subtitle: Monster clocks, bear-trap escapements, tank convoys, cloners and rail switchyards.

4.title: Prism Optics & Transit Networks
4.subtitle: Mirror slaloms, crossed beams, turning force distributors, pocket gates and relays.

5.title: Ballistic Sanctum & Parity Vaults
5.subtitle: Timed blast charges, hurl-stone ricochets, protective wards and toggle parity weaves.

level_1.title: Outer Forebay
level_1.hint: Bridge the western water channel with a boulder and compact the dirt, then cross the central shaft to park the eastern boulder on the red pressure plate.

level_2.title: Counterweight Weir
level_2.hint: Weigh down the red pressure plate in the western chamber to open the shaft gate, then bridge the eastern water channel with the boulder to reach the exit.

level_3.title: Stepped Canal
level_3.hint: Bridge the single water trench in the western room, then sink two boulders in sequence across the eastern double trench, compacting the first dirt tile before pushing the second boulder.

level_4.title: Twin Lock Gates
level_4.hint: Clear the double-trench sluice in the western chamber by compacting the first dirt bridge before pushing the second boulder, then bridge the eastern channel.

level_5.title: Siphon & Balance
level_5.hint: Bridge the two-cell water trench in the western vault with both boulders, then cross the shaft and park the eastern boulder squarely on the blue pressure plate.

level_6.title: Headwater Counterpoise
level_6.hint: Park the western boulder on the red hold plate to unlock the central shaft, then bridge the two-cell eastern water trench one boulder at a time.

level_7.title: Crucible Sluice
level_7.hint: Bridge the western water channel first, then in the eastern chamber push the ice block into the fire to transmute it into water before bridging it with the stone boulder.

level_8.title: Alchemical Spillway
level_8.hint: Quench the western fire barrier with the ice block and bridge the resulting water with the boulder, then cross the shaft to clear the double water trench.

level_9.title: Conveyor Millrace
level_9.hint: Weigh down the red plate in the western chamber, then ride the eastern force conveyor with the boulder to bridge the water trench.

level_10.title: Triple Sluice Bastion
level_10.hint: Traverse all three chambers in sequence: bridge the western channel, weight the central red pressure plate, and bridge the eastern double trench with two boulders.

level_11.title: Glacier Forecourt
level_11.hint: Bank the western boulder around the ice corners to bridge the moat, then cross the shaft and park the eastern boulder on the blue hold plate.

level_12.title: Slipstream Drift
level_12.hint: Feed the western boulder down the conveyor loop into the water trench, then bank the eastern boulder around the ice corner deflector.

level_13.title: Meltwater Conduit
level_13.hint: Slide the western boulder around the ice corners to bridge the channel, then quench the eastern fire barrier with the ice block before bridging the water with the boulder.

level_14.title: Watchman's Toll
level_14.hint: Bridge the western channel to enter the eastern vault, cross the fire strip with Fire Boots, and step across the thief tile to surrender your boots before the exit.

level_15.title: Customs Flume
level_15.hint: Cross the western fire sluice with Fire Boots and pay the thief toll at the exit gate, then guide the eastern boulder down the conveyor current.

level_16.title: Frost Hook Gallery
level_16.hint: Bank the western boulder across the glacier corners, then pick up the Grappling Gloves in the eastern chamber to extract the recessed boulder onto the blue plate.

level_17.title: Current & Counterweight
level_17.hint: Ride the western conveyor sluice to reach the shaft, then bridge the eastern moat with one boulder and pull the recessed second boulder onto the blue plate.

level_18.title: Contraband Alcove
level_18.hint: Clear the western boot-toll vault first, then equip the Grappling Gloves in the eastern chamber to pull the recessed boulder out and weight the blue hold plate.

level_19.title: Tempered Exchange
level_19.hint: Transmute the western fire barrier into water with the ice block and bridge it, then spend the first eastern boulder on the moat and pull the second onto the blue plate.

level_20.title: Cryo Citadel Gatehouse
level_20.hint: Chain three cryo vaults: pay the western boot toll, bank the central boulder around the glacier corners, and swap the eastern boulders with the Grappling Gloves.

level_21.title: Pendulum Escapement
level_21.hint: Wait one beat in the western chamber so the bouncing pink ball lands on the red pressure plate as you step through the hold door, then bridge the eastern sluice.

level_22.title: Ratchet & Pawl
level_22.hint: Step on the brown button in the western chamber to release the trapped tank onto the red plate, then park the eastern boulder on the blue counterweight plate.

level_23.title: Armored Convoy
level_23.hint: Tap the blue button in the western chamber to reverse the tank onto the red hold plate, then bridge the eastern double trench with two boulders.

level_24.title: Ingot Foundry
level_24.hint: Tap the red clone button in the western foundry to fabricate boulders for the water trench, then clear the eastern double sluice.

level_25.title: Switchyard Furnace
level_25.hint: Flip the green button in the western switchyard to divert the rail-guided tank onto the red plate, then quench and bridge the eastern elemental fire channel.

level_26.title: Synchronized Gearwork
level_26.hint: Time the pink-ball clock in the western room to slip past the red hold door, then release the bear-trapped tank in the eastern room onto the blue plate.

level_27.title: Automated Casting
level_27.hint: Reverse the western tank onto the red plate with the blue button, then trigger the eastern red clone button to cast boulders for the water trench.

level_28.title: Spur Line Release
level_28.hint: Free the trapped tank in the western chamber with the brown button, then flip the green switch in the eastern rail yard to route the second tank onto the blue plate.

level_29.title: Foundry Grapple
level_29.hint: Clone a boulder in the western foundry to bridge the trench, then use the Grappling Gloves in the eastern hall to pull the recessed boulder onto the blue plate.

level_30.title: Grand Engine Hall
level_30.hint: Master all three automata rooms: time the western pink-ball clock, cast boulders at the central clone foundry, and switch the eastern railroad track onto the green plate.

level_31.title: Collimator Sluice
level_31.hint: Bridge the western water channel, then push the slash mirror in the eastern optic hall into the beam line to deflect the red laser North into the receiver.

level_32.title: Retractable Lens
level_32.hint: Clear the western double water trench, then equip the Grappling Gloves in the eastern wing to pull the slash mirror out of its recess and push it into the laser beam.

level_33.title: Dual-Spectrum Vault
level_33.hint: Weigh down the red hold plate in the western room, then position both mirrors in the eastern optic chamber so the red and blue laser beams each reach their receivers.

level_34.title: Rotary Prism
level_34.hint: Step onto the turning force floor in the western hub to rotate its push direction and guide the boulder onto the red plate, then align the eastern laser mirror.

level_35.title: Pocket Shuttle & Beams
level_35.hint: Pick up the portable pocket gate in the western room and drop it to teleport across the wall to the red key, then align both crossed laser beams in the eastern chamber.

level_36.title: Refraction Archipelago
level_36.hint: Deflect the western laser beam into the red receiver, then step into the eastern teleport ring and push the island boulder into the water channel.

level_37.title: Turntable Relay
level_37.hint: Use the turning force floor in the western room to seat the boulder on the blue plate, then weight the wired relay plate in the eastern room to open the red signal door.

level_38.title: Logic Transponder
level_38.hint: Weight the wired signal plate in the western chamber to open the red hold door, then deploy the portable pocket gate in the eastern chamber to reach the exit.

level_39.title: Phase-Jump Islands
level_39.hint: Deploy the portable pocket gate in the western room to recover the red key, then ride the eastern teleport ring to bridge the island water trench.

level_40.title: Nexus of the Grid
level_40.hint: Complete the three-chamber transit network: route the western boulder across the turning force tile, power the central signal relay, and navigate the eastern teleport islands.

level_41.title: Breaching Counterweight
level_41.hint: Place a lit blast charge against the western stone barricade and step back before detonation, then cross the shaft to park the eastern boulder on the blue plate.

level_42.title: Ricochet Optics
level_42.hint: Hurl a stone North into the angled mirror in the western vault to detonate the bomb blocking the corridor, then align the eastern prism mirror with the red laser.

level_43.title: Aegis & Toll
level_43.hint: Pick up the protective Ward in the western vault to neutralize the dormant lurker on contact, then clear the eastern fire-boot toll chamber.

level_44.title: Parity Glacier
level_44.hint: Weave the boulder across the dual-channel green and red toggle walls in the western room to weight the blue plate, then bank the eastern boulder across the ice corners.

level_45.title: Ordnance & Sling
level_45.hint: Demolish the western wall barricade with a timed blast charge, then bank a hurled stone off the eastern mirror to clear the bomb guarding the blue plate.

level_46.title: Sentinel Refraction
level_46.hint: Claim the protective Ward in the western chamber to pass the dormant lurker, then align both mirrors in the eastern chamber to light the red and blue laser receivers.

level_47.title: Ballistic Loom
level_47.hint: Ricochet a hurled stone off the western mirror to disarm the bomb, then solve the dual-channel green and red toggle parity weave in the eastern sanctum.

level_48.title: Munitions Foundry
level_48.hint: Fabricate boulders in the western clone foundry to bridge the trench, then plant a timed blast charge in the eastern chamber to breach the central wall.

level_49.title: Warded Parity Sanctum
level_49.hint: Neutralize the western lurker with the protective Ward and weight the green plate, then thread the eastern boulder through the green and red toggle-wall parity weave.

level_50.title: Heart of the Clockwork Citadel
level_50.hint: Conquer the three-chamber citadel finale: time the western pink-ball clock for the green gate, ricochet a hurled stone in the central hall, and solve the eastern parity weave.
